Still cocky, still arrogant, but following through on his promise, he handed over #b#t4031010##k. Maybe he isn't the WORST. Next, I need to gather up #b30 #t4000006#s#k, #b30 #t4000011#s#k, #b30 #t4000012#s#k, and the #b#t4031010##k for #p510#.
